head_commit.message:
Add cron behavior probes for ownership, control, observability, and failure detection

8 workflows that systematically test how GitHub Actions models cron internally:
- basic, multi-schedule, ownership attribution (original 3)
- staleness monitor: detects crons that silently stopped
- chained alerting: workflow_run trigger for cron failure notification
- control API: list/inspect/permission-check via dispatch
- health check: full diagnostic (YAML validity, actor audit, 60-day risk)
- token permissions: tests GITHUB_TOKEN scoping under cron

README includes an internal entity/relationship diagram of how GH must
model repos, workflows, schedules, actors, and permission resolution.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
